top_signals.title: Massive AI Data Center Sparks Backlash Despite Clean Energy Promises
top_signals.summary: As more governments put increasing pressure on tech companies to develop more sustainable data centres, to ensure they do not place a further burden on the grid, several tech firms are investing in developing new energy capacity and incorporating other innovative ideas into their facility development. This has led Google to suggest that the development of its new U.S. data centre in Minnesota, and associated energy development, will have a positive benefit on the region’s transmission network.
